## Analyzer Architecture Summary

- data-science-pipelines (also known as\: DSP, dsp) is a Kubernetes component.
- managing 3 CRD(s)\: CompositeController, ControllerRevision, DecoratorController.
- deploying 10 workload(s) (kubeflow-pipelines-profile-controller, ml-pipeline, ml-pipeline, ml-pipeline, cache-server, metadata-writer, ml-pipeline-persistenceagent, ml-pipeline-ui, ml-pipeline-scheduledworkflow, ml-pipeline-viewer-crd) with 10 container(s).
- watching 1 resource type(s).
- exposing 1 service(s) on ports\: 80.
- Dockerfile EXPOSE ports\: 3000, 8443, 8888.
- protected by 1 network policy/policies.
- connecting to external services\: gcs, grpc, minio, requests, s3.
- runtime dependencies\: MLflow, MinIO/S3, MySQL, PostgreSQL, kubernetes.
- with 1702 operator config constants (10 image references, 9 env vars).
- exposing 50 Prometheus metrics.
- with 2 ingress route(s).
- Python k8s client with 198 API call(s) and 1 CRD kind reference(s).
- integrates with Istio, Prometheus via labels/annotations.
- references components\: argo-workflows (import), kserve (import, provider), kubeflow (import, provider), mlflow (provider, utils), trainer (import, provider).
- mounts 2 ConfigMap(s) as volumes\: kubeflow-pipelines-profile-controller-code, ml-pipeline-ui-configmap.
